title: Keyword Rank Tracker Input
description: Check where a domain appears in Google organic results for a bounded keyword list and location. Rank-provider credentials are supplied by the user and are billed by the provider separately from Apify.

targetDomain.title: Target domain
targetDomain.description: Domain to find in Google organic results, such as example.com. A URL is accepted and normalized to its hostname; subdomains count as matches.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One keyword or search phrase per line. The Actor checks each unique keyword and returns one row even when the target is not found within the selected depth.

locationCode.title: Google location code
locationCode.description: Google location code for the SERP check. The default 2840 is the United States; use a city or country location code for localized tracking.

languageCode.title: Google language code
languageCode.description: Two-letter Google language code such as en, de, or fr.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device profile used for the Google SERP request. Mobile rankings can differ from desktop rankings.

os.title: Operating system
os.description: Operating system paired with the device profile: windows or macos for desktop, android or ios for mobile.

depth.title: SERP depth
depth.description: How many Google result positions to retrieve per keyword. Use 10 for the first page or up to 20 for a bounded second-page check; larger depths are outside this Actor's margin-safe billing envelope.

maxKeywords.title: Maximum keywords
maxKeywords.description: Safety cap applied after duplicate removal. This keeps provider usage and the Apify run cost predictable.

dataforSeoLogin.title: Rank-provider login (legacy key)
dataforSeoLogin.description: Legacy input key for the managed rank-provider login. Prefer rankProviderLogin or Actor environment secrets.

dataforSeoPassword.title: Rank-provider password (legacy key)
dataforSeoPassword.description: Legacy input key for the managed rank-provider password. Prefer rankProviderPassword or Actor environment secrets.

rankProviderLogin.title: Rank-provider login
rankProviderLogin.description: Optional managed rank-provider API login/email. Prefer Actor environment secrets when possible. Never written to output.

rankProviderPassword.title: Rank-provider API password
rankProviderPassword.description: Optional managed rank-provider API password. Sent only in the Authorization header and never written to output.
